data.slice_rule: 12 dev worlds x (object 0/1 x place 0/1) = 48 examples

conditions.a_free: free decode; alpha/beta/gamma from the model
conditions.b_transport: gold record forced, first content byte anchored at the gold span start, pointer free afterwards, gold input prefix
conditions.b_pure: b_transport with gamma forced to 0 (pure copy)
conditions.c_gate: gold record forced and every content position forced; gamma keeps the model value

attribution_rule: b_pure high + c_gate low => gamma gate; b_pure low => beta/transport pointer; c_gate high + a_free low => template/selection
